confirmDelete: Delete this country's starting setup? Your changes here will no longer be included in the export. Any starting setup supplied by the game or other enabled mods will apply.
title: History files
introLine1: Each country's setup is saved in <mono>history/countries/{tag} - z{modname}.txt</mono>. This separate file loads after the original country file; the original file is not edited.
introLine2: To keep an existing setting, follow the empty, 0 or -1 guidance beside its field. Use the advanced script section for settings not available in the form.
setConvoysHelp: Enter the starting number of convoys. Enter 0 to leave the existing number unchanged.
setTechnologyHelp: Enter technology identifiers, separated by commas or new lines. Technologies from the base game are supported; check that each identifier exists in the game or mods you will use.
setOobHelp: Enter the deployment file name from the forces workbench, without .txt. For handwritten deployment instructions, use the advanced script section below.
giveGuaranteeHelp: Enter country codes separated by commas or new lines, such as POL, BEL. Make sure these countries exist in the game or mods you will use.
addToFactionHelp: Enter country codes in the order they should join, separated by commas or new lines. Leave empty to add no countries.
emptyAllHint: Choose how each country starts: its government, elections, national spirits and appearance.
selectHint: Select a history file on the left, or create one.
capitalHelp: Enter the state number containing the capital, such as 361 for Washington. Enter 0 to keep an existing capital. A new country with no existing setup needs a capital.
incrementalUpdate: Update only the settings shown below
fullRewrite: Create or replace the full setup
popularitiesRootHelp: Set support for each ideology group. Leave all values at 0 to keep existing support; otherwise they must total 100.
ideasHelp: Enter identifiers separated by commas or new lines. To add a national spirit, create it in the project's national spirits workbench first; unknown additions are skipped on export. To remove an existing spirit, enter its identifier, such as <mono>undisturbed_isolation</mono>.
focusHelp: Enter focus identifiers separated by commas or new lines. Create these focuses in the project first; unknown focuses are skipped on export.
cosmeticHelp: Choose a set of names and colors for this country at game start. Countries using the same appearance share any changes to it.
startupFlagsHelp: Markers record story conditions at game start, so focuses and decisions can check them later. Enter one identifier per line, for example <mono>{id}</mono>.
dateBlocksDescription: Add changes for a chosen start date. Their order is kept, including separate entries with the same date.
dateBlocksValidationFormat: Use year.month.day or year.month.day.hour, for example 1936.1.1.
rawScriptHelp: This script is included as written, after the form's settings. References are not checked here; test the result in HOI4.
previewUnavailable: This panel does not show a game preview. Edit the country's starting setup in the form, then export and test it in HOI4.

cosmetic.title: Country names and colors
cosmetic.invalidTag: Use 1–100 English letters, digits, underscores, dots or hyphens for the script identifier. It cannot be only . or ...
cosmetic.shared: This appearance is shared by every country using it in this project.
cosmetic.notCreated: This appearance has no names or colors saved in the project yet. Start editing to add them.
cosmetic.loadFailed: Names and colors could not be loaded.
cosmetic.clearHelp: Leave a field empty to use an existing name. Clear a name you entered to return to the name shown beneath the field.
cosmetic.inheritPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the name below
cosmetic.generated: Name based on this appearance's identifier
cosmetic.previewFailed: The preview could not be updated. Your draft is kept.
cosmetic.colorFallback: Uses the existing appearance color or a country color.
cosmetic.conflict: Someone changed these settings. Your draft is kept. Load the latest values to review before saving.
cosmetic.readbackFailed: The latest saved values could not be confirmed. Your draft is kept. Check them before continuing.
cosmetic.saveFailed: Saving failed. Your draft is kept; you can try again.
cosmetic.reviewHelp: Latest saved values are shown below each name. Review your remaining edits, then save.
cosmetic.discardConfirm: Discard your unsaved names and colors?
cosmetic.rawTitle: Other name files may take priority ({count})
cosmetic.rawHelp: Imported files also contain names for this appearance. The game may use those names instead of the ones entered here. Copy the names you want into the form, review and save them. Copying does not change the original files; review those files and test your next export. An empty copied name clears your custom name.
cosmetic.rawCopied: The selected names are in your draft. Review and save them. The original files remain and may still take priority.
cosmetic.rawCopyFailed: Could not copy these values or enable their content language. Your existing draft is kept. Try again.
cosmetic.unassignedImpact: No countries are using this appearance yet.

readbackFailed: Could not confirm that the starting setup was saved. Please try again.

appearance.title: Starting appearance
appearance.stopUsingHelp: After you save the starting setup, only this country will stop using this appearance. Other countries are unaffected.
appearance.pending: Your appearance choice is not saved yet. Save the starting setup.
appearance.saveFirst: Save the starting setup before editing this appearance's names and colors.
appearance.loadFailed: Could not load available appearances. Please try again.
appearance.identifierHelp: Usually no change is needed. To use an appearance from an existing mod, enter its script identifier.
appearance.createdHint: This appearance is for the current country. Other countries can choose to share it.
appearance.creationFailed: Could not create the appearance. Please try again.

ideologySyncHelp: This list is shared with the ideology workbench. New independent groups appear in ruling ideology and support. Subtypes share their parent group’s support.
